message:
release: 0.2.147 -- the file copy helper starts on an elevated host

PC (Windows). On 0.2.146 the host (elevated) could never start GNLinkClipHelper.exe: it took the
linked token, which an elevated process without SeTcbPrivilege receives at Identification level, and
DuplicateTokenEx to a primary token failed with 1346 (seen in this PC's host log 10-01 10:11). The
helper now starts with the current shell's primary token, checked to be the interactive user, in the
host's session, Medium, not elevated, not restricted (Limited or Default), and re-checked after the
duplicate. The duplicate asks MAXIMUM_ALLOWED: with the narrower mask CreateProcessWithTokenW was
denied (err 5) on the user's elevated run; a widened handle mask, not a widened process. The viewer no
longer says "update once more" when the helper failed to start, only when the file is missing.

Feat: helper-shell-token r1..r3 (2525e1d, 59ca050, 29729dd), updater test d257524 (a payload the
install lacks is created, and removed on rollback -- the path 0.2.146 -> 0.2.147 takes to install the
helper on PCs updated from 0.2.145).
Verified: verifier's independent runs (helper e2e 149/0, net e2e 325/0, gates, updater suites);
the user's elevated check on the pinned test build 2026-10-01 15:58: ALL PASS (High host -> Medium
helper, interactive user, Job, Hello, StatFiles, Shutdown exit 0); Codex source review OK.
Not verified: the in-app update 0.2.146 -> 0.2.147 on a real install, and the two-PC copy/paste.

Product: version only. Test: none. Docs: none.
